name: SkillRegistry::discover

test_list.description: Index user-global and repository metadata while keeping repository skills unapproved.
Changed content invalidates the lazy-load index.
Ambiguous skills within one trust tier fail deterministically.
Restore approval only for the exact source digest and reject changed content.
Missing optional roots are empty and file paths cannot be used as roots.
The directory handle reader rejects files larger than the source limit before parsing their contents.
Symlinked directories and skill files are ignored.
A post-index file symlink to an outside target is rejected, including at the capability-relative open boundary.
A root path replaced after indexing cannot redirect lazy reads away from the pinned skill directory.
On Windows, the pinned skill directory remains readable while rename is denied; rename succeeds after releasing the registry handle.
Index the configured maximum skill count with bounded discovery.

output_description: Bounded metadata index with lazy body loading and explicit trust state.
